cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: the EXCLUDE Clause section is headed by a bare 'Couchbase Server 8.0' badge/label with no further qualification ('### EXCLUDE Clause \n Couchbase Server 8.0 \n ```ebnf exclude-clause ::= ...'), functioning as a literal version-gate citation despite Capella having no discrete version numbers - the same pattern flagged in optimizer-hints.json's 'In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later...' and comma.json's 'Couchbase Server 7.6' citation.
